nom: VICHY Normaderm Acne Control Daily Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: I've been using the face wash of the same brand for several months now, and after a bad bout with acne I decided to implement their moisturizer into my skincare routine as well. I love the way it smells (sort of peppermint-y). The pump works really well and I love the glass container. Before, I was using Clean and Clear moisturizer, and this one feels like it absorbs better. I have pretty sensitive skin, and the face wash has worked really well for me so I hope this one will as well

It is effective for treating acne and controlling excess sebum, although if you have very sensitive skin it can cause irritation. Although it almost doesn't happen, it's a good product in general, he recommended that you also buy the facial cleanser for more results
Smells great and works well. Reduces the size and appearance of pimples overnight.

avis.titre: Fantastic moisterizer that also serves as an anti-aging product!
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer! Although it's touted as a product for oily, acne-prone skin, it works wonderfully on my combination skin. I love the way it gives my skin a beautiful texture, and it never feels heavy. It seems to help tighten my skin and reduce the appearance of sun spots and other imperfections. I'm 64, and my skin looks great in part due to this product. I wear it during the day under sunscreen, and it never feels heavy or greasy. I would say it's a little on the expensive side, but it's frequently on sale, and I stock up. My husband also uses it, and it works perfectly on his dry, sensitive skin. Neither of us wants to do without it. I'm usually impressed by French skincare products, and this moisturizer holds true to form.

Realmente con este producto note cambios visibles en mi piel muy rápido. Funciona para el acné, mi piel es acneica y brota fácilmente pero con este serum no me han salido últimamente. También se siente muy fresco en la piel.

This has been so wonderful for my acne prone skin I’ll be buying another bottle as soon as I run out! But hopefully that won’t be too soon as just a little of the serum seems to go a long way. This has 3 primary acne fighting ingredients in it- salicylic acid, kaolin and zinc. All of which are gentle enough for sensitive skin types but proven to be effective against acne. It’s really helped to keep mine under control as well as heal existing breakouts. Thankfully it’s also been working well to fight my maskne when I wear this under my mask. It is not very hydrating once it’s dried, so I layer a moisturizer on top and I’m good to go. The emerald green glass bottle is really beautiful too and feels very high end. A great product from Vichy, love this serum. Hope this review helps 🌼

This Vichy Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturizer is a much needed product. It provides acne treatment without causing the skin to become overly dry and red. I suffer from adult acne, and my skin is still very oily even though I am in my 40s. This moisturizer really does help combat my breakouts while providing hydration to my skin. I seem to have less oily breakthrough along my t-zone when I use this moisturizer regularly. It works amazingly well with my other skin care and also with the makeup I apply daily. On the days when I go without makeup, I still put this moisturizer on. I will never go without it!

This is my new favorite moisturizer. I've been having breakouts from wearing a mask and I started using this and my skin is so much better after almost a week of using it. I do my cleanser first and put this on before bed. It didn't make my skin oily either!

avis.titre: Smooth Texture; Gorgeous Packaging; Okay Acne Control
avis.texte: This moisturizer is my first experience using a product from Vichy Laboratories. This acne control daily moisturizer comes as part of the Normaderm Phytoaction line. For quick reference, I have mature, sensitive, product-sensitive, fair, acne-prone, congestion-prone, combination skin. I've battled some form of acne for the last 30+ years. These days it is well managed with gentle but consistent use of topical acne medications (which are applied only a few nights a week, not every time I wash my face). Per the description: "Discover Vichy Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturizer that helps to clear acne and visibly improve skin tone and texture. Formulated with 2% Salicylic Acid, Pure Hyaluronic Acid, and Vitamin C, this clinically tested formula specifically targets acne blemishes, blackheads & enlarged pores. Refreshing, light-weight texture easily glides onto skin & is absorbed quickly. Leaves skin feeling soothed & hydrated. Suitable for oily, acne-prone & sensitive skin types. Suitable for adult acne." What I like: The vibrant, emerald green glass bottle is lovely. You get 1.69oz of product in a hygienic pump. The lotion is light-weight, gel-like, and absorbs quickly into the skin. It is oil-free, silicone-free, non-greasy, and mattifying. avis.titre: Great for sensitive acne prone skin
avis.texte: If you have sensitive acne prone skin, you may like this. It isn't too watery or too thick. Feels comfortable, and layers well under makeup. Doesn't smell too strong, and great to use alone as well. I use it after a face wash and it keeps my skin a boost of moisture. It's made in France as well. I pair it with it's corresponding facial wash and it works very well. Works well for men as well. doesn't feel oily or sticky for those that do not like wearing lotions because of the feel of most moisturizers. Overall, highly recommended.

I have been using this product for two weeks now. I usually use it in the morning after washing my face. It goes on smoothly and has a light scent. This has 2% salicylic acid which helps to keep my skin clear. I didn’t dry out with this product and I find it more moisturizing than similar products. It’s paraben and oil free, which is also a plus. I will continue to use this product.
